# Purpose
The `sales_analysis.R` script processes raw synthetic transaction data to calculate monthly revenue totals and generates a bar chart of the results.

## Inputs
* `synthetic_sales.csv`: A comma-separated values file containing `Date`, `ProductID`, and `Revenue`.

## Outputs
* A cleaned data frame grouped by month.
* A `.png` bar chart visualizing monthly revenue.

## Code Example
Below is an example of how the script loads and processes the data:

```r
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Load data
sales_data <- read_csv("data/synthetic_sales.csv")

# Clean and aggregate
monthly_summary <- sales_data %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Total_Revenue = sum(Revenue))
```
